protocol.feature_history: Strictly earlier source seconds; complete equal-second groups score before update
protocol.feature_event_rate: log1p(prior global count/max(1,current second-first observed source second))
protocol.feature_normalization: Use relative count/rate features instead of raw cumulative counts to reduce trivial elapsed-history drift; no stationarity guarantee
protocol.feature_elapsed: log1p(min(86400,seconds since last event))/log1p(86400); unseen history uses 86400
protocol.learning: Unsupervised IsolationForest; no benign or malicious training labels
protocol.reservoir: Uniform Algorithm R over warmup event rows; canonical user/computer ordering inside each second; duplicates retain event multiplicity
protocol.fit_scope: Each release/month fits six forests on warmup only; validation selects parameters, test never fits or selects
protocol.forest_score: floor((-score_samples)*10000)/10000; larger means more unusual, not attack probability
protocol.threshold: Conservative validation upper-score budget; never split tied bins; disable if top tie exceeds allowance
protocol.history_update: All observed rows update feature and baseline histories irrespective of alert or label; forest weights remain frozen after warmup
protocol.tail: Exclude the complete final source-second group of each incomplete compressed prefix
protocol.batching: Batch up to8192 distinct within-second user/computer feature vectors; multiplicities weight all metrics and calibration
protocol.test_reuse: 2015 and month00 windows were inspected previously; retrospective diagnostics. Month01 is another same-institution slice without attack labels.

tuning.all_other_settings: Identical fixed estimator settings and warmup reservoir
tuning.validation_split: First half of validation source-time span calibrates1% thresholds; later half measures budget stability, whole seconds only
tuning.objective: Minimize abs(later validation alert fraction-0.01), not detection accuracy
tuning.eligibility: Both validation halves nonempty, at least two calibration score bins, non-null calibration threshold
tuning.tie_break: Smallest max_samples, then smallest max_features, then stable candidate ID
tuning.fallback: Fixed max_samples256/max_features1.0 if no eligible candidate; disclose fallback
tuning.final_threshold: Recalibrate selected candidate on all validation only; freeze before test
tuning.test: Evaluate fixed forest plus selected forest and every count control; do not select a test winner

protocol.reporting: Report every fixed method and regression; never choose a winner from held-out outcomes or replace runtime policy
